 Home Education Today News NTA clarifies JEE Main 2027 application process for NRI candidates without Aadhaar NTA clarifies JEE Main 2027 application process for NRI candidates without Aadhaar
 NTA has introduced an Aadhaar-free application option for NRI candidates applying for JEE Main 2027 Session 1. Applicants without Aadhaar but holding valid Indian passports can register through a dedicated option online.
 advertisement NRI applicants without Aadhaar can now register for JEE Main 2027 India Today Education Desk New Delhi, UPDATED: Nov 10, 2026 08:46 IST The National Testing Agency (NTA) has issued an important clarification for Non-Resident Indian (NRI) candidates applying for JEE Main 2027 Session 1. Candidates without an Aadhaar card but holding a valid Indian passport can complete their applications through a dedicated NRI registration option on the official website, jeemain.nta.nic.in.
 The update comes as registration for the January session remains underway, with the application deadline approaching on November 22, 2026.
 advertisement Read More NRI CANDIDATES WITHOUT ADHAAR: HOW TO APPLY
 According to NTA's latest update on X, eligible NRI applicants must select the 'Apply through the NRI (Having No Aadhaar)' option while registering for JEE Main 2027 Session 1.
 Candidates can visit jeemain.nta.nic.in, open the Session 1 registration portal and choose the designated option to proceed with their application using a valid Indian passport.
 The facility is specifically intended for NRI applicants who do not possess Aadhaar but have a valid Indian passport.
 Screecshot of NTA's tweet. 
 IMPORTANT DATES
 The JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration process began on October 24, 2026. Candidates can submit their application forms until November 22, 2026, up to 11:50 pm.
 advertisement Applications with a late fee can be submitted between November 23 and November 26, 2026. The application correction window will remain open from November 27 to November 29.
 NTA will conduct JEE Main 2027 Session 1 on January 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28.
 EXAM PATTERN AND DURATION
 According to the examination details provided by the NTA, the duration of the examination will vary depending on the paper selected by candidates.
 Paper 1 (B.E./B.Tech.): 3 hours
 Paper 2A (B.Arch.): 3 hours
 Paper 2B (B.Planning): 3 hours
 B.Arch. and B.Planning (both): 3 hours and 30 minutes
 The examination will be conducted in two shifts. The first shift will begin at 9 am, while the second shift will begin at 3 pm.
 For examinations with a duration of three hours, the first shift will conclude at 12 noon and the second shift at 6 pm. For the 3-hour-and-30-minute examination, the first shift will conclude at 12:30 pm and the second shift at 6:30 pm.
 For more details, candidates are advised to visit the official website of NTA.
